title: Microsoft employees call work ‘joyless’ in open letter as 60,000 get buyout offers
content: Microsoft employees are circulating an open letter accusing the company of pursuing AI at all costs, saying work there has become "joyless and demoralizing." The letter is gaining attention after Microsoft offered buyouts to 60,000 employees across India, the US, UK and Canada, its largest ever. It flags forced AI use, layoffs, data centres and climate goals, as staff report raises below 1% while Microsoft posts a 32% profit jump.

title: Ohio homeowner refuses to pay for basement flaws; court upholds $45,806 bill
content: An Ohio homeowner was ordered to pay a contractor $45,806 for a concrete foundation with cosmetic flaws. The court found that structural integrity was maintained, despite visible surface defects. The homeowner had initially refused payment, claiming that the imperfections reduced property value. The appeals court upheld the lower court decision, emphasizing the importance of structural safety over cosmetic issues.

title: Portion of false ceiling collapses outside Mumbai airport terminal 2; 1 injured
content: On Sunday, a visitor was injured when part of the false ceiling at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport collapsed, according to airport officials. The unfortunate event occurred outside Terminal 2. First aid was administered swiftly by the airport's emergency medical team. Authorities are currently investigating the cause of the collapse and are also checking the structural safety of the adjacent ceiling area.

title: Queen Elizabeth II's final days at Balmoral's 53,000-acre Scottish estate
content: Queen Elizabeth II spent her final days at Balmoral Castle, her beloved Scottish retreat spanning 53,000 acres. The royal estate held decades of cherished family memories, offering her peace and comfort amid nature. From royal summer holidays to her final moments, discover why Balmoral remained one of the Queen’s most treasured places throughout her life.

title: Grandmother raised grandson from infancy; court bars joint adoption with partner
content: In a landmark decision, North Dakota’s Supreme Court ruled that unmarried couples are barred from adopting a child together, as dictated by existing state law. This case involved a grandmother and her partner who intended to adopt her grandchild, with agreement from both biological parents. The court clarified that only legislative changes can alter adoption laws, while allowing individual adoption requests from either of the parties involved.

title: California rejects wealth tax backed by Sergey Brin, despite support from AI hubs
content: California's Proposition 40, which aimed to impose a one-time tax on billionaires, has been rejected by voters. Major financial contributions from billionaires, including Sergey Brin, influenced the outcome significantly. While the measure garnered support in major cities like San Francisco and Los Angeles, Silicon Valley's votes were predominantly against it. Opponents of the tax also introduced counterpropositions to ensure its defeat.

title: Woman spends $110,000 on home with partner; court rejects claim after split
content: After her relationship concluded, Mary Roth pursued the return of over $110,000 she invested in home enhancements. However, the North Dakota Supreme Court determined that she could not secure restitution through an unjust enrichment claim. The ruling underscored that Roth needed to demonstrate an actual financial benefit to the property owner, something her receipts failed to do when it came to increasing the property's market value.

title: 'Slippers, scooter outside firm': Woman found dead in office; family alleges murder
content: A 20-year-old woman was discovered hanging in a finance company office located in Gorakhpur. Her family has alleged that her death was a murder, pointing to the office manager as a suspect. After her mother searched for her, she found her daughter hanging when she reached the office. Protests erupted outside the finance company as villagers demanded a thorough investigation.

title: Court overturns $31,054 divorce payout over premarital home's rise in value
content: The West Virginia Supreme Court of Appeals has overturned a previous decision regarding a premarital home. The court ruled that the husband is not liable for the home's market value increase during marriage. This ruling clarifies how separate property and marital contributions are treated in divorce cases. However, the former wife is entitled to financial interest from mortgage principal payments made during the marriage.

title: India gets its 100th Grandmaster! Anuj Shrivatri becomes first GM from MP
content: Anuj Shrivatri made history by becoming India's 100th chess Grandmaster and the first from Madhya Pradesh after winning the 7th ASEAN Plus Individual Open Chess Championship on Diwali. The 2004-born player recovered from an opening defeat to finish with seven points. His achievement marks a major milestone for Indian chess, 38 years after Viswanathan Anand became the country's first Grandmaster.

title: Firecrackers on 2-wheeler explode in UP's Bahraich, injure 4 including 2 bystanders

The incident occurred near Padma Market on Saturday night, causing significant panic in the area. Among the injured, Nimesh Srivastava sustained serious injuries and was taken to a medical college for treatment. The other three youths, Aman, Abhishek, and Amit Pandey, were treated and later discharged from the hospital.

title: Kanpur hit-and-run: Thar mows down scooter rider, drags him 20 metres on Diwali eve
content: A 55-year-old man named Santosh Singh Chauhan was killed in Kanpur after an out-of-control Thar struck him. The incident occurred in Awas Vikas 3, Kalyanpur, dragging him and his scooter approximately 20 meters. Witnesses reported that the occupants of the Thar screamed post-accident before driving away in another vehicle. Police have seized the Thar and are reviewing CCTV footage for investigation.

title: ‘Don’t talk to pups’: Drama unfolded at Faridabad police station hours before murder

Before the shooting, Sharma had threatened Dhankar at a police post, warning he would not leave him alive. The incident escalated when Sharma called Dhankar to discuss the car parking issue. Following the shooting, police teams collected evidence from the scene at the housing complex.

title: Nearly 100 fall ill after eating pani puri, tikki from street vendor in UP villages

Affected individuals reported symptoms such as vomiting and diarrhoea shortly after eating the food. Medical teams from local health departments were deployed to assist and monitor affected residents. Investigations are ongoing to determine the source of the contamination linked to leftover food ingredients.

Drawing on survey findings and expert perspectives, the story examines how schools can integrate AI without compromising critical thinking, subject knowledge and learning skills.

title: 1 killed, 3 injured in two shootings in North Carolina university
content:
At least one person was killed and three other injured in two separate shootings at a historically Black university in North Carolina during its homecoming weekend, police said on Sunday. Both incidents took place on Saturday at Winston-Salem State University, assistant police chief Jason Swaim of the Winston-Salem Police Department said. However, authorities have yet to establish whether the shootings were connected. Police are investigating the incidents and have declared the campus safe. The lockdown imposed earlier has also been lifted. Swaim did not disclose whether any arrests had been made. "The investigation is still very early in its preliminary stages," Swaim said at a press conference early Sunday.
